name: TeamCymruScout
title: Team Cymru Scout API Poller
descriptionMarkdown: This connector ingests Team Cymru Scout threat intelligence and account usage data into Microsoft Sentinel. It polls the Scout REST API using API key authentication, retrieves usage statistics, advanced search results, detailed IP enrichment, and foundation lookups, and writes the normalized records to custom Log Analytics tables.

sampleQueries.description: Show recent Team Cymru Scout usage statistics

sampleQueries.query: TeamCymruScoutSearch | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | project TimeGenerated, ip, country_codes, event_count, query

sampleQueries.description: Review IP enrichment records includes open ports and PDNS
sampleQueries.query: TeamCymruScoutIPDetails | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | project TimeGenerated, ip, as_name, net_name, sections

customConnector.description: The connector uses Team Cymru Scout's API key authentication model (Authorization: Token: <api_key>). It polls the Scout API at an interval and ingests records from /api/scout/usage, /api/scout/search, /api/scout/ip/{ip}/details, and /api/scout/ip/foundation.

polling.notes: The Scout API omits date parameters unless explicitly required. By default, it returns data for the last 30 days.

settings.name: apiKey
settings.description: The Team Cymru Scout API key issued during account setup. Use the format Authorization: Token: <api_key>.

settings.name: baseUrl
settings.description: Hostname and path for the Scout API. This can vary by deployment.

settings.name: query
settings.description: Default Scout Query Language expression for the search poller.

settings.name: lookbackDays
settings.description: Number of days of historical data to request from Scout when the API default is not used.
